chars.DAD: a Moroccan man in his late 50s with a short grey beard, wearing a cream djellaba over a white collared shirt and brown leather babouches
chars.SON: a Moroccan man around 27 with a neat fade haircut, wearing a fitted burgundy suit jacket over a white open-collar shirt and black trousers
chars.MOM: a Moroccan woman in her 50s wearing an emerald green kaftan and a beige headscarf
chars.HOST: a Moroccan woman around 50 wearing a dark navy kaftan with gold trim, black hair tied back in a low bun

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a traditional Moroccan salon with low cushioned sofas during an engagement visit in Casablanca: DAD suddenly stands up with a stern frozen face, HOST sits pale and stiff opposite him, a dropped silver tea tray and spilled glasses on the carpet, SON on the sofa looking up confused

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: DAD grabs a big bouquet of red roses and a wrapped chocolate box back from the low table with determination, SON beside him with hands raised in disbelief, Moroccan salon background

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Awkward silence in a Moroccan salon: HOST stares at the floor, MOM and SON exchange puzzled looks, nobody understands what is happening, warm evening light

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: DAD walks out of an apartment door into a stairwell first, MOM and SON follow behind him carrying the roses and chocolate box, faces confused, Moroccan apartment building

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Night street in Casablanca, DAD walks ahead silent and shocked as if struck on the head, staring into nothing, MOM and SON walking behind him whispering

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: SON walking on a night street looking anxiously at his smartphone, sending messages with no reply, worried face lit by the phone screen, street lamps behind

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Modest Moroccan living room at night: DAD sits on the sofa and firmly points to the seat next to him, SON in his burgundy jacket hesitantly sitting down, tense atmosphere

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Close two-shot in a Moroccan living room: DAD leans toward SON with a very serious warning look, one finger raised, SON stares back wide-eyed, waiting to hear a secret
